notes: Full growth_curve.sas pipeline verbatim except the two hardcoded Windows Excel export paths (F:\00_coding\...\growth_parameters.xlsx) rewritten to relative ./growth_parameters.xlsx so PROC EXPORT runs. Fits a logistic growth curve per animal with PROC NLIN (Marquardt), computes R-squared via PROC SQL, transposes/merges parameter estimates and std errors, exports to xlsx, and plots observed vs predicted with PROC SGPLOT. Data is the author's inline DATALINES (4 animals, 37 rows).
